title: P99 SSO WebSocket Protocol
description: Normative machine-readable wire contract for the WebSocket channel between the P99 login proxy (client) and the roboToald SSO server. Each message is a JSON object discriminated by its `type`. Bulk payloads (account_tree, changes) are loosely typed so the server can evolve their internals without breaking clients; unknown extra fields are permitted everywhere for the same reason. For flows, crypto, RBAC, and implementer checklists see docs/backend-protocol.md (additive guide; must not diverge from this schema).

full_state.description: Server -> client. Full snapshot of the accessible account tree. Working server and proxy always exchange account_tree, count, and dynamic tag lists.

login_auth_response.description: Server -> client. Result of a login_auth request. On success `real_user` and `encrypted_credentials` are present; on failure `error` (and `status`) are present.

ping.description: Keepalive. Either direction (server typically sends; client may also send).

error.description: Server -> client. Terminal error / auth rejection. Working server always sets `detail`; proxy UI reads `detail` only. `message` / `reason` are optional aliases.

auth.description: Client -> server. First message after connect; authenticates the session.

login_auth.description: Client -> server. Request real credentials for an alias/tag.

heartbeat.description: Client -> server. Periodic liveness for a logged-in character.

update_location.description: Client -> server. Character park/bind/level/item updates. All fields besides character_name are optional. Legacy clients may send `keys`; server merges with `items` (`items` wins on conflict).

fte.description: Client -> server. First-to-engage report for a raid mob.

mob_death.description: Client -> server. Raid mob death report.
